fields.Name: TxnServiceSequence
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: Stores the sequence of services being executed within a transaction. In a compound transaction or container transactions that calls other container transactions, multiple services may be called. Since all of them are having the same TxnId and TxnDate, this field is then used to indicate the sequence of services being executed.
